scope: All 10 files in the pinned Git tree, including .gitignore and the root README. Methods are grouped by operation; changing a key, page, radius, or hash algorithm does not create another method-family record.

status_definitions.replayed: A bounded local implementation independently reproduced a specified source output using pinned source files and declared LP inputs.
status_definitions.runnable_with_inputs: The source gives an executable rule and all exact inputs, but no local replay has been recorded.
status_definitions.missing_rule_or_input: The exact source rule or required source bytes are absent; a fresh test would make additional assumptions.

method_families.specific_cases: 43 rune keys in the ZIP applied to each of 58 source page files; the README wordlist omits the archive's final DIVINITY key.
method_families.rule_status: No source generator script is supplied. GP subtraction, key phase zero and uninterrupted rune advance are recovered from source output and verified by 2,365 nine-rune-prefix comparisons on 55 rune-bearing LP2-00–55 pages.
method_families.finding_scope: None of nine fixed 12-rune known-reading openings occurs at a replayed page start; this does not validate the source's unquantified no-good-result judgment for full outputs.
method_families.unresolved: The original script, its exact plaintext scoring rule, and any nonzero key phases are not supplied. The local record does not assess all 58 source pages.

method_families.specific_cases: Two radii (zero-based GP index or GP prime value), each compared with nearest rounding and integer truncation; source output covers pages 0–56.
method_families.rule_status: README states round(2πR) mod 29, while both archived output files implement truncation. The local record exposes both rather than silently choosing one.
method_families.finding_scope: Both truncated variants reproduce nine-rune prefixes on all 55 rune-bearing pages on LP2-00–55. The prime-radius map reaches only 18 of 29 output symbols; no language criterion was supplied.
method_families.unresolved: The source's interesting-result criterion is unspecified, and its page 56 output is outside the local LP2-unsolved scope.

method_families.kind: Historical image/hash lookup, outside LP2 rune solving
method_families.specific_cases: The script calls sha512sum and b2sum on 75 original JPEGs and searches for the concatenated 128-hex-character page-56 target. The archived text contains 75 SHA-512 and 75 BLAKE2 rows and no literal target match.
method_families.rule_status: Hash algorithms and target are specified, but the script references an external liber-primus__images--full directory absent from this pinned Git tree.
method_families.finding_scope: Only the archived checksum table has been counted and searched; original image bytes were not independently rehashed against this source's corpus.
method_families.unresolved: Exact 75 JPEG input bytes and their provenance must be pinned before an independent replay. This is not evidence for or against an LP2 rune cipher.

note: This inventory closes this one pinned repository tree, not public Liber Primus repositories generally.
